messages:
maria: quick copy review — we're updating the "Preserve state" modal that appears when users stop instances from the Console. want a tight wording pass + a11y check before we ship. screenshot in thread.
choi: current modal headline is 'Preserve state?' which reads like a question. i'd prefer an action-oriented header: 'Save session state' or 'Create snapshot before stopping'.
ben: agreed. product wants the language to clearly communicate the tradeoff: snapshot takes time but prevents data loss; stopping is fast but may lose unsaved state. keep the primary CTA short.
rachel: small UX ask: show a subtle warning icon and short one-line summary plus an expandable details block for full consequences. reduces modal clutter.
maria: proposed header: 'Save session state before stopping' body: 'Creating a snapshot saves running session state to persistent storage. Stopping without a snapshot may lose unsaved work and stops compute billing.' primary button: 'Stop instance' (red) but aria-label: 'Stop instance without saving session state' secondary button: 'Create snapshot' tertiary: 'Cancel'
choi: prefer 'Create snapshot' as the safer prominent action (not primary) but visually we can emphasize it with a green outline. important: default focus should be on Cancel.
accessibility-bot: accessibility notes: 1) use role="alertdialog" if there's potential data loss, 2) avoid autofocus on destructive controls, 3) add aria-describedby linking the primary to the explanatory paragraph, and 4) ensure the snapshot button announces progress via aria-live polite. Also make sure button color choices meet contrast guidelines.
ben: product asks whether to include billing language in the first sentence or a short parentheses after. customers react strongly to billing surprises. i propose: '... and stops compute billing.' keep it short.
rachel: copy nit: change 'unsaved work' -> 'unsaved session state' to be precise.
maria: draft copy blob for devs to paste: 

"header": "Save session state before stopping",
"body_id": "preserve-desc",
"body": "Creating a snapshot saves your running session state to persistent storage. Stopping without a snapshot may lose unsaved session state and stops compute billing.",
"buttons": ["Cancel", "Create snapshot", "Stop instance"],
"attributes": {"stop_aria": "Stop instance without saving session state", "snapshot_live_region": "snapshot-status"}

Note: buttons should appear left-to-right: Cancel | Create snapshot | Stop instance (red). Default focus -> Cancel.

accessibility-bot: additional: include i18n keys: modal.preserve.title/body/primary/snapshot/cancel. ensure the link text for docs is descriptive: e.g., 'How snapshots work'.
devops-bot: implementation note: snapshot creation can be long — we should surface an inline spinner and prevent concurrent 'Stop' while snapshot in progress. add analytics events: modal.preserve.snapshot_started/completed/stop_confirmed.
ben: tiny language tweak: replace 'creates a snapshot' -> 'create a snapshot' to match imperative voice in UI.
choi: microcopy finish: change body to: 'Create a snapshot to save your running session state to persistent storage. Stopping without a snapshot may lose unsaved session state and will stop compute billing.'
maria: OK locking on this. i'll update Figma and add to the PR. devs, please follow a11y checklist before merging. :white_check_mark:
